articles.summary: TDM provisions records. Generators make plausible inputs. Combinatorial tools optimize the rows. The expected result stays hand-kept in a spreadsheet. Karate's decks ship every row with the computed answer, and any framework can run them.
articles.title: Every test-data tool generates the question. Ours ships the answer.

articles.summary: A contract run that passed, and still told us what it did not check. Walking the public policy-api report: 12 scenarios matched, 5 of 7 operations compared, and the two it named by hand.
articles.title: Your tests are green. Two of your seven operations were never compared.

articles.summary: Coverage says your tests ran. It cannot say whether they would notice a bug. API mutation testing seeds defects into provider behavior, replays your suite, and hands back the survivors: the bugs no test would catch.
articles.title: Your coverage is green. Would your tests notice if the code broke?
